blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.
blocks.zh: AI研究代理人将提出,实施,评估实验的周期自动化,开启了递归自我改进的道路. 然而,它们提出实验的能力超过了在实际环境中进行实验的能力,使结果预测成为在有限的实验预算下持续自我改进的关键能力。 我们作为研究世界模型(RWMs)来调查语言模型,预测各种研究环境中候选干预的结果。 我们的评估利用了来自9个研究环境的2,600多份实验记录,这些研究环境涵盖培训前、培训后和推断,代表了超过171,000个H100 GPU小时的实验。 从实际实验经验中获得的研究知识改进了RWM对同一环境中的无形干预的预测(Spearman + 0.27),并且可以跨环境重复使用. 例如,仅使用OLMo3,Marin和Nanochat的预训经验,与零经验设定相比,RWM在Qune3环境中将选择遗憾减少了78%. 这些好处扩大到在固定选择预算下进行多轮自动研究:拥有内在和跨内在研究知识的RWMs分别提高了15.8%和11.6%。 用于RWMs的13种语言模型的分布表明,增加研究知识比改变模型或增加推理努力更能改进干预排名. 这些调查结果支持作为RWMs的语言模型,并激励为未来的RWM培训积累实验数据.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: AI research agents ( Yamada et al., 2025 ; Schmidgall et al., 2025 ) are automating the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Karpathy, 2026 ) , opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them: a plausible, implementable intervention is cheap to generate but expensive to test ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , and deciding whether it deserves training or evaluation budget still requires anticipating its actual effects. For example, changing a learning-rate schedule or training-data mixture ( Xie et al., 2023 ) may improve performance with one model and budget but offer little benefit, or even hurt performance, with another. Under limited budgets, this uncertainty directly affects which interventions can be explored and how quickly effective improvements are found. Predicting outcomes before execution therefore has direct research value: it helps researchers and research agents compare candidate interventions and allocate resources to more promising experiments ( Snoek et al., 2012 ; Klein et al., 2017 ) . This need spans pretraining, post-training, and inference, motivating a predictive capability that can serve multiple research environments by anticipating intervention outcomes in each of them.
blocks.zh: AI研究代理商(Yamada等,2025;Schmidgall等,2025.)正在使实验的提出,实施和评价周期自动化(Lu等,2024;Karopathy,2026.),开启了递归自我改进之路. 然而,它们提出实验的能力超过了它们执行实验的能力:一种可行的、可执行的干预是低成本的,但测试费用却很高(Kaplan等人,2020年;Hoffmann等人,2022年),并且决定它是否值得培训或评估预算仍然需要预测其实际效果。 例如,改变学习率表或培训-数据混合体(Xie等,2023年)可能用一种模式和预算来改善业绩,但用另一种模式和预算来改善业绩,不会带来什么好处,甚至会损害业绩。 在有限的预算下,这种不确定性直接影响到可以探讨哪些干预措施以及如何迅速找到有效的改进。 因此,执行前的预测结果具有直接的研究价值:它有助于研究人员和研究人员比较候选干预措施,并为更有希望的实验分配资源(Snoek等人,2012年;Klein等人,2017年)。 这需要涵盖培训前、培训后和推论,激发一种预测能力,通过预测每个研究环境的干预结果为多种研究环境服务。

blocks.en: To satisfy such prediction needs, we formulate and study the Research World Model (RWM): a single model that serves multiple research environments by predicting the outcome of executing a candidate intervention in its respective environment (Figure 1 ). This perspective draws on world models ( Hafner et al., 2019b ; Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ; Chua et al., 2018 ) , which support decisions by predicting the consequences of actions ( Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2019a ) ; here, the experimental intervention plays the role of the action, the research environment provides the context in which it is taken, and the experimental outcome is the consequence to be predicted. The research environment specifies the reference model, data, experimental configuration, budget, and evaluation setup. An experimental intervention specifies one or more executable changes relative to this starting point, and its outcome is measured under the environment’s evaluation protocol after execution. Researchers or research agents can use RWM predictions to compare candidates, select the next experiment, and incorporate newly observed outcomes into subsequent decisions.
blocks.zh: 为了满足这种预测需要,我们制定并研究了研究世界模型(RWM):一个单一模型,通过预测在各自环境中执行候选干预措施的结果,为多种研究环境服务(图1)。 这一视角借鉴了世界模型(Hafner等,2019b;Schrittwieser等,2020;Chua等,2018),这些模型通过预测行动的后果来支持决定(Ha等,2018;Hafner等,2019a) ;在这里,实验干预扮演了行动的作用,研究环境提供了采取行动的背景,实验结果就是要预测的后果. 研究环境规定参考模型,数据,实验配置,预算,评价设置. 实验性干预指定了与这个起点相关的一个或多个可执行变化,其结果在执行后按照环境评价协议来测量. 研究人员或研究代理人可以使用RWM预测来比较考生,选择下个实验,并将新观察到的结果纳入后期决定.

blocks.en: Language models are a natural candidate for implementing RWMs: they possess prior knowledge of models and training methods, and they can read descriptions of research environments and candidate interventions expressed in natural language, code, and configurations ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) . Prior work has shown that language models can use experimental experience within a single task ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) to assist optimization and research ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Foster et al., 2026 ) . The interventions we consider range from hyperparameter adjustments to changes in model architectures, training objectives, and optimization mechanisms, applied in research environments with different foundation models, training recipes, and compute budgets. Because the same intervention can have different effects in different environments, predicting its outcome requires accounting for the environment in which it is applied. We therefore focus on a question that prior studies have not directly answered: can research knowledge acquired from real experiments in one environment help predict intervention outcomes in another? This question concerns whether experimental experience can accumulate into research knowledge that serves multiple research environments, rather than remaining tied to the environment that produced it.
blocks.zh: 语言模型是实施RWMs的自然候选:它们具有对模型和培训方法的先入为主的知识,它们可以读取用自然语言,代码和配置表达的研究环境和候选干预的描述(Brown等,2020;Chen等,2021). 以前的工作表明,语言模型可以在一项单一任务(郑等,2026年)内利用实验经验来协助优化和研究(刘等,2024年;福斯特等,2026年). 我们认为,干预范围从超参数调整到模型结构的变化、培训目标和优化机制,运用于具有不同基础模型的研究环境、培训方法以及预算计算。 由于同样的干预在不同环境中会产生不同的效果,因此预测其结果需要对其应用的环境进行核算. 因此,我们侧重于一个以前的研究没有直接回答的问题:在一个环境中从实际实验中获得的研究知识能否帮助预测另一个环境中的干预结果? 这个问题涉及实验经验是否能够积累到为多种研究环境服务的研究知识中,而不是与产生这种知识的环境联系在一起。

blocks.en: Our evaluation draws on 2,653 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing 171,862 H100 GPU-hours of real experimentation. We distinguish two prediction settings: in-environment prediction (in-env) uses experimental records from the same environment to predict unseen interventions, whereas cross-environment prediction (cross-env) uses records from other environments to predict unseen interventions in a target environment. Our experiment reveals that large language models can learn from real experimental experience: across five environments in the in-env setting, research knowledge raises mean Spearman correlation on unseen interventions from 0.506 to 0.774. This knowledge can also be reused across environments: without any target-environment records, knowledge from other environments raises mean Spearman correlation from 0.628 to 0.729 across five pretraining environments. These predictive gains translate into better experiment selection. When selecting three of sixteen candidates, in-env research knowledge raises mean normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank three (NDCG@3) from 0.599 to 0.785 across five environments, and cross-env knowledge reduces macro-average Regret@3 by 52.2% across five autoregressive pretraining environments. In multi-round Autoresearch on OLMo3-100M, initializing RWMs with in-env or cross-env research knowledge increases mean final best gain by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively, relative to no initial research knowledge under the same budget of 24 experiment selections (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的评估利用了来自9个研究环境的2,653个实验记录,这些研究环境涵盖培训前、培训后和推断,代表了171,862个H100 GPU小时的实际实验。 我们区分两种预测环境:环境内预测(in-env)使用同一环境的实验记录来预测隐蔽的干预,而跨环境预测(cross-env)则使用其他环境的记录来预测目标环境中的隐蔽干预. 我们的实验表明,大型语言模型可以从真实的实验经验中学习:在五种环境的内在环境中,研究知识使斯皮尔曼在看不见的干预上具有平均的相关性从0.506到0.774. 这种知识也可以在各种环境中再利用:如果没有目标环境记录,其他环境中的知识将五个培训前环境中的斯皮尔曼平均相关性从0.628提高到0.729。 这些预测收益转化为更好的实验选择. 在选择16名候选人中的3名时,in-env研究知识在5个环境中提高了三级(NDCG@3)的正常累积收益,从0.599到0.785,跨env知识在5个自发性前训练环境中将宏观平均遗憾@3减少52.2%。 在对OLMo3-100M的多轮自动研究中,初始化的RWMs具有env或cross-env研究知识,意味着最终最佳收益分别增加15.8%和11.6%,而根据24个实验选择的相同预算(图2),没有初始研究知识。

blocks.en: Ablations on OLMo3-100M further show that adding research knowledge improves intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. Across 13 language models, Spearman correlations without additional research knowledge range from − 0.362 -0.362 to 0.621; with research knowledge they range from 0.638 to 0.896, so even the weakest model with knowledge exceeds the strongest model without it. Holding the model fixed, raising reasoning effort from LOW to MAX increases Spearman correlation from 0.609 only to 0.648, whereas keeping LOW effort and adding research knowledge raises it to 0.892. Within the tested settings, insufficient relevant research knowledge is thus a more prominent bottleneck for RWM prediction than limited reasoning effort, supporting the accumulation of research knowledge as a central direction for developing RWMs.
blocks.zh: OLMo3-100上的损坏 M还表明,增加研究知识比改变模型或增加推理努力更能改善干预排名。 纵观13个语言模型,没有额外研究知识的斯皮尔曼关联介于−0.362-0.362到0.621之间;有研究知识的斯皮尔曼关联介于0.638到0.896之间,因此即使知识最弱的模型也超过了没有它的最强模型. 持有模式固定,将推理努力从LOW提升到MAX,使斯皮尔曼的关联性从0.609只提升到0.648,而保持LOW努力并增加研究知识则提升到0.892. 因此,在经过试验的环境下,与有限的推理努力相比,相关研究知识不足是RWM预测的一个更突出的瓶颈,有助于积累研究知识,作为发展RWM的中心方向。

blocks.en: Together, these results establish the empirical viability of large language models as RWMs, connecting (1) learning from experimental experience, (2) reuse of research knowledge across environments, and (3) value for research decisions. They show that real experiments do more than test the interventions at hand: they produce research knowledge that benefits subsequent research, within and beyond the environment that generated it . This work acquires and reuses such knowledge through in-context learning ( Garg et al., 2022 ; Xie et al., 2021 ) , providing an empirical basis for collecting research data and training dedicated models. Our long-term goal is to train RWMs on large and diverse collections of research data, enabling them to continually accumulate research knowledge and develop predictive capabilities that serve multiple research environments, so that research agents can direct limited experimental budgets toward the most promising interventions.
blocks.zh: 这些成果共同确立了作为RWMs的大型语言模型的经验可行性,连接了(1)从实验经验中学习,(2)跨环境再利用研究知识,(3)研究决策的价值. 它们表明,真正的实验不仅能检验手头的干预:它们产生研究知识,在产生这种知识的环境内外,有利于随后的研究。 这项工作通过内文学习获取并再利用此类知识(Garg等,2022;Xie等,2021),为收集研究数据和培训专用模型提供了经验依据. 我们的长期目标是对RWMs进行大型和多样化的研究数据收集培训,使其能够不断积累研究知识并发展为多种研究环境服务的预测能力,从而使研究人员能够将有限的实验预算用于最有希望的干预。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Our evaluation spans nine research environments across pretraining, post-training, and inference (Table 1 ). The corpus totals 2,653 records, accounting for 171,862 H100 GPU-hours. We first evaluate whether research knowledge improves outcome prediction within and across environments. We then test whether these predictive gains translate into better experiment selection under a fixed budget and better outcomes in multi-round Autoresearch. Finally, we compare the predictive benefits of research knowledge, backbone choice, and reasoning effort.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价涵盖九个研究环境,包括培训前、培训后和推断(表1)。 保单共记录2,653个,为171,862个H100 GPU小时. 我们首先评价研究知识是否改善了环境内外的成果预测。 然后,我们测试这些预测收益是否转化为在固定预算下更好的试验选择,以及多轮自动研究的更好结果。 最后,我们比较研究知识、骨干选择和推理努力的预测效益。

blocks.en: Table 1: Research environments and experimental scale. In-env and Cross-env indicate prediction-evaluation coverage.
blocks.zh: 表1:研究环境和实验规模。 in-env和Cross-env表示预测-评价覆盖范围.

blocks.en: We refer to the language model used to implement the RWM as its RWM backbone. Our default RWM backbone is Claude Opus 5 with a 1M context window and HIGH reasoning effort.
blocks.zh: 我们把用于实施RWM的语言模型称为其RWM主干. 我们的默认RWM主干线是克洛德·奥普斯5,拥有1M上下文窗口和HHI推理努力.

blocks.en: We compare W 0 W_{0} , which receives no experimental records ( H = ∅ H=\varnothing ), with W in − env W_{\mathrm{in-env}} , which receives records from the evaluated environment. The RWM backbone and inference settings are held fixed across knowledge conditions. We include k k -nearest-neighbor regression (kNN) and ridge regression, which receive the same experimental records and candidate inputs as the record-conditioned RWM. Their hyperparameters are selected using only the permitted history. Each static prediction evaluation uses a single fixed split shared by all predictors. All aggregate statistics and reported improvements are computed before rounding. Appendix C.2 specifies the baseline inputs and hyperparameter selection.
blocks.zh: 我们比较没有实验记录的W 0 W_{0} (H = ∅ H=\varult ) , W 在- env W_{\mathrm{ in-env}} ) , 接收来自评估环境的记录. RWM的主干线和推论设置在知识条件下固定不变. 我们包括k-近邻回归(kNN)和脊回归,它们得到与有记录条件的RWM相同的实验记录和候选输入. 他们的超参数只使用允许的历史来选择. 每一次静态预测评价都使用由所有预测器共享的单一固定分出. 在四舍五入之前,将计算出所有汇总统计数据和所报告的改进。 附录C.2规定了基准投入和超参数选择。

blocks.en: 3.2 Research Knowledge Improves RWM Predictions
blocks.zh: 3.2 研究知识改进RWM预测

blocks.en: We evaluate predictions of unseen interventions in two settings: in-environment (in-env), where records come from the evaluated environment, and cross-environment (cross-env), where they come from other environments. We use mean absolute error (MAE) to measure the difference between predicted and measured gains, where lower values are better, and Spearman correlation to measure agreement between rankings by predicted and measured gains, where higher values are better.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两种情况下的隐蔽干预的预测:环境内部(en-env),记录来自被评价的环境;以及跨环境(cross-env),它们来自其他环境。 我们用平均绝对误差(MAE)来测量预测得分和测量得分的相差,其中较低值比较好,而斯皮尔曼关联用预测得分和测量得分的相差来测量排名之间的一致,而较高值比较好.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 In-Environment Prediction (In-Env)
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 环境预测

blocks.en: Within-environment records improve gain prediction and intervention rankings in all five environments, increasing mean Spearman correlation by 0.27 over W 0 W_{0} (Table 2 ). The record-conditioned RWM also outperforms kNN and ridge on both metrics in every environment, which shows that language models acting as RWMs can learn more effectively from experimental experience.
blocks.zh: 环境内部记录改善了所有5个环境的增益预测和干预排名,平均Spearman的关联性比W 0 W = 0 = 0 = (表2 )增加了0.27个。 创纪录的RWM在每种环境中都优于克NN和脊,这表明作为RWMs的语言模型可以更有效地从实验经验中学习.

blocks.en: Table 2: Within-environment prediction performance. Each environment uses a single fixed split. History denotes context records supplied to W in − env W_{\mathrm{in-env}} ; Test denotes the number of held-out candidates.
blocks.zh: 表2:环境内部预测业绩。 每个环境都使用一个固定分块. 历史表示以-env W_{\mathrm{ in-env}} 提供给W的上下文记录; 测试是指被搁置候选人的人数。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Cross-Environment Prediction (Cross-Env)
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 跨环境预测

blocks.en: We take each of five autoregressive pretraining environments in turn as the target. W cross − env W_{\mathrm{cross-env}} uses 244 records from the other four environments to predict gains for 71 interventions in the target environment. The target environment and reference setting are provided, with no target-environment records. The held-out interventions and their near-duplicate groups are excluded from the source records. kNN and ridge receive the same source records.
blocks.zh: 我们把五个自相递进的先行环境逐一作为目标。 W cross-env W_{\-mathrm{cross-env}}-用其他四种环境的244个记录来预测目标环境中71个干预措施的收益. 提供了目标环境和参考设定,没有目标环境记录。 被搁置的干预及其近似重复的群体被排除在来源记录之外。 kNN 和 ridge 获得相同的来源记录.

blocks.en: Table 3: Cross-environment prediction performance. Macro is the equal-weight mean over target environments.
blocks.zh: 表3: 跨环境预测性能。 宏是相对于目标环境的等重平均值.

blocks.en: Source-environment records improve Spearman point estimates in all five targets (Table 3 ); paired bootstrap confidence intervals are reported in Appendix D.1 . Yet kNN, which outperforms W 0 W_{0} on four in-env panels, falls below it on every transfer target (macro-average Spearman 0.36 v.s. 0.63). kNN can struggle to capture how interventions depend on their environment: semantically similar changes may correspond to different modifications under different target recipes.
blocks.zh: 源环境记录改善了所有5个目标的斯皮尔曼点估计(表3);对接的靴子置信间隔在附录D.1中报告。 然而,在4个内置面板上表现优于W 0 W_{0}的kNN,在每一个转移目标上都低于它(宏观平均斯皮尔曼0.36 v. 0.63). kNN可以拼命捕捉干预措施如何依赖其环境:在不同的目标食谱下,类似变相可能对应不同的修改.

blocks.en: For example, Nanochat already uses Muon. For a Muon optimizer variant, source kNN predicts + 0.018 +0.018 BPB from mostly beneficial source analogues, but the measured gain on Nanochat is − 0.036 -0.036 . W 0 W_{0} predicts − 0.035 -0.035 . This case illustrates how source analogues can mislead under a different starting recipe, even when source records improve aggregate rankings.
blocks.zh: 例如,纳诺查特已经使用了穆恩. 对于Muon优化变体,源kNN预测+0.018+0.018 BPB来自大多数受益源类比,但所测纳诺恰特增益为-0.036-0.036. W0 W_{0}预测-0.035-0.035. 这个案例说明了源类比在不同的起步配方下如何会误导,即使源记录改善了汇总排名.

blocks.en: 3.3 RWM Predictions Improve Experiment Selection
blocks.zh: 3.3 RWM预测改进实验选择

blocks.en: Good global rankings (Spearman) need not identify the few highest-gain candidates. In a typical Autoresearch round, an agent receives multiple proposals and must choose the most promising few to execute. We simulate an execution budget of roughly 20% by selecting three interventions from each pool of 16 candidates. Specifically, we evaluate 200 random partitions of the test candidates into shared pools; each predictor selects its three highest-ranked candidates. Random reports the exact expected score of uniformly selecting three candidates.
blocks.zh: 良好的全球排名(Spearman)不需要确定几个得分最高的候选人. 在典型的"自动研究"一回合中,代理接受多个建议,必须选择最有前途的几个执行. 我们模拟了大约20%的执行预算,从每个16名候选人中挑选出3人。 具体地说,我们评价200个随机将考试候选人分成共用人才库;每个预测者选择其三个排名最高的候选人。 随机报告一致选择三名候选人的准确预期得分。

blocks.en: Regret@3 measures the gain lost by missing the best candidate. NDCG@3 evaluates the positive gains and ordering of the selected interventions. Appendix D.2 defines the metrics, candidate grouping, and aggregation.
blocks.zh: 遗憾@3 衡量因缺少最佳候选人而损失的收益。 NDCG@3评价所选干预措施的积极成果和顺序。 附录D.2界定了衡量标准、候选类别和汇总。

blocks.en: The equal-weight mean of the per-environment relative reductions in Regret@3 from W 0 W_{0} to W in − env W_{\mathrm{in-env}} is 58.2%. NDCG@3 also improves in every environment (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 每一环境相对减少的等重平均值为58.2%。 NDCG@3 在每个环境也有所改善(表4)。

blocks.en: In cross-env selection, W cross − env W_{\mathrm{cross-env}} reduces macro-average Regret@3 by 52.2% relative to W 0 W_{0} , where each macro average weights the five target environments equally. Both Regret@3 and NDCG@3 improve in all targets except Marin (Table 5 ). Both feature-based baselines have higher macro-average Regret@3 than W 0 W_{0} .
blocks.zh: 在交叉env选择中,W交叉-env W_{\mathrm{cross-env}将宏平均遗憾@3相对W0W_{0}减少52.2%,其中每个宏平均对五个目标环境的权重相等. 除了Marin(表5)之外, 两个基于地物的基线的宏观平均遗憾@3比W 0 W_{0}要高.

blocks.en: Using the observed mean API cost of Claude Opus 5 (1M context, HIGH reasoning effort), scoring 16 candidates with one call each costs approximately $6.3. The median of the nine environments’ average compute costs per experiment is 42.3 H100 GPU-hours (Table 1 ), or approximately $127 at $3 per GPU-hour. Thus, scoring 16 candidates costs approximately 5% of one representative experiment.
blocks.zh: 采用Claude Opus 5(1M上下文,高考推理努力)观察到的API平均成本,评分16名候选人,每名1通电话,费用约为6.3美元。 9个环境平均计算成本的中位数是42.3H100GPU小时(表1),即每GPU小时3美元约127美元。 因此,评分16名候选人花费了一个代表性实验的5%。

blocks.en: Table 4: Mean within-environment experiment-selection performance. Metrics are averaged over 200 shared random partitions of each environment’s fixed test panel, selecting three candidates from each pool of 16.
blocks.zh: 表4:环境内平均实验选择表现。 每个环境的固定试验板平均有200多个共享的随机分块,从每个16人中挑选出3名候选人。

blocks.en: Table 5: Mean cross-environment experiment-selection performance. Metrics are averaged over 200 shared random partitions of each target’s fixed test panel, selecting three candidates from each pool of 16. Macro is the equal-weight mean over target environments.
blocks.zh: 表5:平均跨环境实验选取性能。 平均计算每个目标固定试验板200多个共享随机分区,从每组16人中选出3名候选人。 宏是相对于目标环境的等重平均值.

blocks.en: 3.4 Multi-Round Autoresearch
blocks.zh: 3.4 多径自动研究

blocks.en: We further examine whether RWMs can discover higher-gain interventions under the same experiment-selection budget in multi-round Autoresearch. We conduct five Autoresearch evaluations on OLMo3-100M, each with eight rounds. Sixteen new candidate interventions are introduced each round, and each method selects three interventions from those currently available, for a total selection budget of 24 per evaluation. We compare three initial RWM settings: W 0 W_{0} receives no experimental records, W in − env W_{\mathrm{in-env}} receives 244 records from the same environment, and W cross − env W_{\mathrm{cross-env}} receives 244 records from other environments. We also compare against kNN and ridge using the same cross-environment records. Within each evaluation, all methods receive the same new candidates each round and have the same selection budget. Results are averaged over the five evaluations. Appendix E specifies candidate arrivals, experimental feedback, and scoring.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查在多轮自动研究中,RWM能否在同样的试验选择预算下发现高回报的干预。 我们对OLMo3-100M进行了5次自动研究评价,每轮8发. 每轮采用16个新的候选干预措施,从现有干预措施中选择3个干预措施,每次评价的总甄选预算为24个。 我们比较了三个最初的 RWM 设置: W 0 W_{0} 没有收到实验记录, W 在- env W_{\ mathrm{ in-en-v} 收到了来自同一环境的244个记录, W cross- env W_{\ mathrm{ cross-env}} 收到了来自其他环境的244个记录. 我们还使用同样的跨环境记录与kNN和脊相比较。 在每次评价中,所有方法每轮都收到相同的新候选人,而且甄选预算相同。 5个评价的结果是平均的。 附 录 E具体规定了候选人抵达、实验反馈和评分。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Multi-round Autoresearch on OLMo3-100M. Means over five Autoresearch evaluations, each with eight rounds. (a) Best-so-far gain (BPB). (b) nAULC (%), computed by normalizing each evaluation’s curve area by that of its matched Arrival Oracle and then averaging across evaluations.
blocks.zh: 图2: OLMo3-100M上的多轮自动研究. 意味着超过5个自动研究评价,每个有8个回合. (a) 最佳收益。 (b) nAULC (%),按每份评价的曲线区域与相应甲骨文的曲线区域正常化计算,然后在各种评价中平均计算。

blocks.en: We use final best gain to measure the largest gain available by the end of the evaluation, including the unchanged reference with zero gain. We use normalized area under the learning curve (nAULC) to assess the entire research process: finding high-gain interventions earlier yields a higher nAULC. The 100% reference for nAULC is an ideal selector (Arrival Oracle) that knows the measured gains in advance but receives the same new candidates each round and has the same selection budget as the other methods. Higher values are better for both metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们利用最后的最佳收益来衡量在评价结束时可获得的最大收益,包括未变的零收益提法。 我们利用学习曲线(naULC)下的常态领域来评估整个研究过程:更早的发现高收益干预产生更高的nAULC. NAULC百分之百的参考是一个理想的选择者(Arival Oracle),它事先知道所衡量的收益,但每轮都接收到相同的新候选人,并且有与其他方法相同的选择预算. 较高的数值对两个衡量标准都比较好。

blocks.en: Within-environment records improve both early discovery and final gains. Initializing RWMs with in-environment or cross-environment records increases mean final best gain by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively, relative to W 0 W_{0} under the same budget of 24 selections (Figure 2 ). Cross-environment records approach the performance of within-environment records and outperform the feature-based predictors initialized with the same source records. These results extend the value of cross-environment knowledge reuse from single-round experiment selection to multi-round research.
blocks.zh: 环境内部的记录改善早期发现和最终收益。 初始化的RWMs具有环境内或跨环境记录,意味着最终最佳收益分别增加15.8%和11.6%,而W0 W_{0}则在同一预算下增加24个选择(图2)。 跨环境记录接近环境内部记录的性能,并超越了以同一源记录初始化的基于特征的预测器. 这些结果将跨环境知识再利用的价值从单回合实验选择扩大到多回合研究.

blocks.en: 3.5 Research Knowledge, Backbone Choice, and Reasoning Effort
blocks.zh: 3.5 研究知识、后骨选择和理性努力

blocks.en: On the OLMo3-100M prediction panel, we compare five reasoning-effort levels for Claude Opus 5 and 13 RWM backbones. Each configuration is evaluated with and without experimental records using Spearman correlation. Appendix C.3 gives the comparison settings.
blocks.zh: 在OLMo3-100M预测面板上,我们比较了克洛德·奥普斯5和13个RWM主干线的五个推理-努力水平. 每个配置都使用斯皮尔曼关联性(Spearman conversation)的实验记录与无实验记录来评价. 附录C.3提供了比较设置。

blocks.en: Figure 3: RWM rankings on OLMo3-100M across (a) backbones and (b) Claude Opus 5 reasoning-effort settings.

blocks.en: Providing experimental records improves rankings more than increasing reasoning effort: even LOW with records outperforms every effort setting without records (Figure 3 b).

blocks.en: Experimental records improve rankings for all 13 backbones, and the two performance ranges do not overlap: the lowest-performing backbone with records exceeds the highest-performing backbone without them (Figure 3 a). On this panel, changing the backbone alone does not compensate for missing experimental evidence. Together, these two findings motivate collecting more experimental records to expand the research knowledge available to LLM-based RWMs and further improve their predictions.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our results suggest that experiments produce reusable knowledge beyond testing individual interventions. Experimental records can improve prediction and guide subsequent research, including across environments. This motivates preserving environment descriptions, interventions, and outcomes, including experiments that do not improve performance. The demonstrated benefits arise through in-context learning, with cross-environment evidence currently limited to autoregressive pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,实验产生的可重复使用的知识超出了测试个别干预措施的范围。 实验记录可以改进预测并指导随后的研究,包括跨环境的研究. 这促使人们保留环境描述、干预措施和成果,包括不改进业绩的实验。 所证明的好处是通过文字上的学习,而跨环境证据目前仅限于自发的先行训练。

blocks.en: A natural next step is to train RWMs on diverse experimental records and compare their generalization with in-context learning in unseen environments. Integrating RWMs into sustained research also raises the question of how to balance immediate improvement against acquiring knowledge for future decisions. Evaluating such systems requires measuring research progress and total costs, including data acquisition, inference, and execution, since better predictions alone do not guarantee more effective research.
blocks.zh: 下一个自然步骤是培训RWMs掌握各种实验记录,并将其概括化与无形环境中的内文学习进行比较。 将农村妇女纳入持续研究也提出了如何平衡眼前的改进与为未来决策获取知识的问题。 评估这种系统需要衡量研究进展和总成本,包括数据的获取、推断和执行,因为仅靠更好的预测并不能保证更有效的研究。

blocks.en: AI use statement

blocks.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools to refine hypotheses and provide feedback on the experimental design, to implement and debug the data-processing, evaluation, and analysis code, to clean and reformat experimental records into the tables reported in the paper, and to assist in interpreting results. We have not used generative AI tools to generate synthetic datasets, to develop the conceptual framework or notation, to formulate mathematical claims or write proofs, or for translation; qualitative and thematic data analysis is not applicable to this work. Additionally, we used generative AI tools to draft and edit parts of the paper, suggest its structure, summarize and identify related literature, format references, create or modify figures, and edit LaTex source. Separately, language models are the object of study in this paper and serve as the research world model under evaluation; that use is part of the method and is described in Sections 2 and 3 rather than here. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work: AI-generated code was inspected and tested by the authors, all reported numbers were recomputed from the raw experimental records, factual claims and citations were checked against source material, and the framing, methodology, and conclusions were decided by the authors. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies whether prior experimental records can reduce unnecessary experimental runs, but constructing those records and evaluating research world models also consumes substantial compute; Table 1 reports the H100 GPU-hours used to produce the experimental records so that efficiency claims can be weighed against this cost. The methods are dual use: better prediction and allocation could accelerate safety and efficiency research, but could equally accelerate capability development or concentrate advantages among organizations with large experimental archives. All experimental records were produced by the authors’ own experimental runs on public models and datasets; the study involves no human subjects and collects no personally identifiable information. Before release, we will review records, code, and prompts for licensing and security concerns and document their provenance and known limitations.

blocks.en: Automated research agents connect idea generation, implementation, execution, and feedback into iterative scientific workflows. ResearchAgent generates and revises research ideas using scientific literature and feedback from reviewing agents ( Baek et al., 2025 ) ; the AI co-scientist develops hypotheses through a generate–debate–evolve process guided by research objectives ( Gottweis et al., 2026 ) . These systems address the construction and refinement of research proposals. The AI Scientist extends automation through experimentation and paper writing ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , while its second version introduces agentic tree search for experimental exploration ( Yamada et al., 2025 ) . Agent Laboratory organizes literature review, experimentation, and report writing around a human-provided research idea, with opportunities for human feedback ( Schmidgall et al., 2025 ) . Autoresearch iterates over code modifications, short training runs, and measured improvements ( Karpathy, 2026 ) . AIRA 2 scales experimental search through asynchronous execution, consistent evaluation, and interactive debugging ( Hambardzumyan et al., 2026 ) . AutoLLMResearch learns configuration policies in a multi-fidelity environment, including extrapolation from cheaper experiments to expensive configurations ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . MLAgentBench and MLE-bench complement these systems with evaluations of multi-step machine learning experimentation and engineering ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Chan et al., 2025 ) . Together, these works establish the workflows and evaluation settings in which research prediction can be useful. When candidates outnumber affordable executions, forecasting offers a way to prioritize the experiments that receive resources.

Agent Laborator 组织文献审查,实验,并围绕人类提供的研究思想撰写报告,并有机会得到人类反馈(Schmidgall等,2025年). 自动研究对代码修改,短训运行,并测量改进(Karopathy,2026.) . AIRA 2通过同步执行,一致评价,互动调试等方法进行实验搜索(Hambardzumyan等,2026年). blocks.en:
Predicting experimental performance to allocate computation has a substantial history. Bayesian optimization uses surrogate models and previous evaluations to select promising hyperparameters, including settings with variable evaluation costs ( Snoek et al., 2012 ) . Learning-curve models predict performance across configurations and can extrapolate partially observed training curves ( Klein et al., 2017 ) . Performance predictors for architecture search also use architecture, hyperparameter, and partial-training features to estimate final performance and enable early stopping ( Baker et al., 2017 ) . These approaches illustrate several prediction interfaces; some use measurements from the candidate’s ongoing execution, whereas our queried interventions are assessed without their execution outcomes. At a broader scale, language-model scaling laws relate loss to model size, data, and compute ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) , compute-optimal training studies their allocation under a fixed budget ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , and DoReMi optimizes data-mixture weights with a proxy model before training a larger model ( Xie et al., 2023 ) . These findings provide concrete examples of why experimental conditions matter, without resolving prediction for arbitrary code-level interventions.
LLAMBO brings language models into surrogate modeling and candidate sampling through in-context historical evaluations, including numerical forecasts with empirical uncertainty estimates ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Research preference models compare candidate plans and code with previously evaluated solutions; their inference-only and agentic variants differ in whether they additionally run pilot experiments ( Foster et al., 2026 ) . Predict-Before-Executing studies pairwise solution preference, motivates prediction through implicit world modeling, and incorporates it into the ForeAgent predict-then-verify loop ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Further work compares research ideas by their expected empirical benchmark performance ( Wen et al., 2026 ; Mule et al., 2026 ) . Beyond AI research, SciPredict evaluates natural-science outcomes and reports limitations in accuracy and confidence calibration ( Sehwag et al., 2026 ) ; social-science forecasting by simulated participant responses achieves substantial correlations with measured treatment effects but systematically overestimates effect sizes ( Ashokkumar et al., 2026 ) . These are precedents for forecasting and decision support, with reliability and information requirements that depend on the prediction task.
blocks.zh:
预测实验性能分配计算有相当的历史. Bayesian优化使用替代模型和之前的评价来选择有希望的超参数,包括具有可变评价成本的设置(Snoek等人,2012年)。 学习曲线模型预测了跨配置的性能,并可以推断出部分观察到的训练曲线(Klein等,2017. 建筑搜索的性能预测器也使用架构,超参数和部分训练特征来估计最终性能并使得能提前停止(Baker等,2017.). 这些办法说明若干预测的界面;有些是使用候选人执行中的衡量标准,而我们所询问的干预是在没有执行结果的情况下评估的。 在更广泛的范围内,语言模型缩放法将损失与模型大小、数据和计算联系起来(Kaplan等,2020年),计算-优化培训研究其在固定预算下的分配(Hoffmann等,2022年),DoReMi在培训更大的模型之前用代理模型优化数据混合权重(Xie等,2023年)。 这些结论提供了具体实例,说明实验条件为何重要,而不解决任意代码级干预的预测。
LLAMBO通过内文历史评价,包括带有经验性不确定性估计的数字预测(Liu等,2024年),将语言模型引入了代模型和候选采样中. 研究偏好模型将候选计划和代码与之前评价的解决方案进行比较;其仅推论和代理变体在是否额外运行试点实验上有所不同(Foster等,2026年). 预测-前-执行研究对等的解决方案偏好,通过隐含的世界模型来激励预测,并将其纳入前置剂预测-当时的验证循环(郑等,2026年). 进一步的工作根据其预期的经验性基准业绩来比较研究想法(Wen等,2026;Mule等,2026)。 除了AI研究之外,SciPresident评价自然科学的结果和报告在准确性和信心校准方面的局限性(Sehwag等,2026年);通过模拟参与者反应进行的社会科学预测与测量的处理效果有着实质性的关联,但系统地高估了效果大小(Ashokkumar等,2026年)。 这些是预测和决策支持的先例,其可靠性和信息要求取决于预测任务。

blocks.en: In-context learning enables frozen language models to condition predictions on examples ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . Controlled studies show that Transformers can learn new functions from input–output demonstrations ( Garg et al., 2022 ) , while a latent-concept account explains the emergence of in-context learning as implicit Bayesian inference under specific pretraining assumptions ( Xie et al., 2021 ) . These results offer mechanisms and controlled evidence for using context, rather than a guarantee of transfer in arbitrary research settings. Code-generation models provide another relevant capability: mapping natural-language specifications to executable programs ( Chen et al., 2021 ) . For interactive agents, ReAct interleaves reasoning with actions that acquire information from external sources ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . Reflexion turns feedback into verbal reflections for later trials ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , ExpeL extracts and retrieves knowledge across training-task experiences ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , and Voyager accumulates an executable skill library for later tasks ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Algorithm Distillation learns from reinforcement-learning histories so that subsequent policy improvement can occur in context without parameter updates ( Laskin et al., 2022 ) . Its target is adaptive action selection; our target is predicting the outcomes of proposed research interventions. This distinction motivates evaluating experimental records as predictive evidence in their own right, including when the records and queried intervention come from different environments.
blocks.zh: 文中学习使被冻结的语言模型能够以实例作为预测的条件(Brown等人,2020年)。 受控制的研究表明,变形人可以从输入-输出演示(Garg等,2022年)中学习出新的功能,而潜入概念的叙述则解释了在具体训练前假设下隐含的贝叶斯人推论的出现(Xie等,2021年). 这些结果为利用上下文提供了机制和受控制的证据,而不是在任意研究环境中转让的保证。 代码生成模型提供了另一个相关能力:将自然语言的规格映射到可执行程序(Chen等,2021年). 对于互动代理,ReAct将推理与从外部获取信息的动作交互(姚等,2022.). 折射将反馈转化为后期试验的口头反思(Shinn等,2023年),ExpeL取出并取回跨培训任务经验的知识(Zhao等,2024年),Voyager为后期任务积累可执行技能库(Wang等,2023年). 算法分解从强化学习的历史中吸取了教训,从而可以在不更新参数的情况下改进政策(Laskin等人,2022年)。 它的目标是选择适应性行动;我们的目标是预测拟议研究干预的结果。 这种区分促使评价实验性记录本身作为预测性证据,包括当记录和询问干预来自不同环境时。

blocks.en:
World-model approaches use learned consequences of actions to support planning and control. World Models learns compact spatial and temporal representations ( Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , PlaNet plans with latent dynamics inferred from pixels ( Hafner et al., 2019b ) , and Dreamer learns behavior through imagined trajectories ( Hafner et al., 2019a ) . DreamerV3 extends the applicability of a common learning algorithm and configuration across diverse domains ( Hafner et al., 2023 ) ; this concerns broad applicability of the learning procedure, not evidence that a single frozen model transfers directly to every environment. PETS propagates uncertainty through probabilistic dynamics models ( Chua et al., 2018 ) , and MBPO limits the effects of model error through short model-generated rollouts branched from real data ( Janner et al., 2019 ) . These methods connect model quality, uncertainty, and the reliability of decisions made using predictions.
Planning models can also emphasize decision-relevant quantities: MuZero learns a recurrent model that predicts rewards, values, and policies without requiring reconstruction of full observations ( Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ) . Broader proposals for autonomous intelligence similarly emphasize predictive models for reasoning and planning ( LeCun, 2022 ) . These precedents motivate explicit attention to what a world model predicts and how its predictions are used.
In AI research, WMRL queries a language model with a task and an agent-generated solution, predicts execution outcomes, and uses the resulting scores for RL post-training; real-execution anchors correct bias and reduce update variance ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . It is a direct precedent for approximating research-environment interactions with language models. 1 1 1 AI-Supervisor also uses “Research World Model” for a persistent knowledge graph of methods, benchmarks, limitations, and research gaps ( Long, 2026 ) . Our usage concerns action-conditioned prediction of experimental outcomes. Our experiments assess the measured gain of a complete research rollout, rather than multi-step control or observation reconstruction. We study how experimental knowledge improves this prediction within and across research environments, including targets without local outcome records, and whether the predictions improve experiment selection under fixed budgets.
blocks.zh:
世界示范办法利用行动的经验教训支持规划和控制。 世界模型学会了紧凑的空间和时间表现(Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018),PlaNet计划带有从像素推断出的潜在动态(Hafner等, 2019b),而Dreamer则通过想象的轨迹学习行为(Hafner等, 2019a). 梦中人 V3将共同学习算法和配置的可适用性扩展到了不同的领域(Hafner等,2023年);这涉及学习程序的广泛可适用性,而不是证明一个被冻结的模型直接转移到了每一个环境. PETS通过概率动态模型传播不确定性(Chua等,2018年),而MBPO通过从真实数据中分出短模型产生的推出分支来限制模型出错的影响(Janner等,2019年). 这些方法将模型质量、不确定性以及利用预测作出的决定的可靠性联系起来。
规划模式还可以强调与决策相关的数量: MuZero学习了一个经常性的模型,预测奖励、价值和政策,而不需要重建完整的观测(Schrittwieser等,2020年)。 比较广泛的自主智能建议同样强调推理和规划的预测模型(LeCun,2022.). 这些先例促使人们明确关注世界模型的预测及其预测如何使用。
在AI研究中,WMRL询问带有任务和代理生成的解决方案的语言模型,预测执行结果,并使用所得出的分数进行RL后训练;实际执行主锚纠正了偏差并减少了更新差异(Yang等,2026). 这是将研究与环境互动与语言模型相近的直接先例。 1 1 AI-监督员还使用“研究世界模式”来绘制关于方法、基准、局限性和研究差距的持久知识图(长,2026年)。 我们的用法是对实验结果的有行动条件的预测。 我们的实验评估了全面展开研究而不是多步骤控制或观察重建的得益。 我们研究实验知识如何在研究环境内部和相互之间改进这种预测,包括没有当地结果记录的目标,以及预测是否改善固定预算下的试验选择。

We conduct five Autoresearch evaluations, each with eight rounds. Each evaluation
samples 128 interventions from a pool of 231 unseen OLMo3-100M candidates,
disjoint from the initial within-environment history. Candidate arrivals are
organized by mechanism complexity, with 16 new candidates per round.
Unselected candidates remain available. Within each evaluation, all methods
share the candidate set and arrival schedule, and prediction ties are
resolved by ascending fixed candidate ID.
